rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Having considered the candidacy submitted by the President for the post of Chairman of the Government, under Article 103(1)(a) of the Constitution, the State Duma resolves, on the results of a secret ballot, to give the President consent to the appointment of Chernomyrdin Viktor Stepanovich as Chairman of the Government, and to send the resolution to the President. Signed 'Г. Н. Селезнев', Moscow, 10 August 1996, N 624-II ГД.
